verdict.rationale: Anrok explicitly markets global coverage — dashboard showing tax obligations across 13 countries with UK registration threshold tracking, automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions, worldwide exposure map, and pricing page listing 'Registration handled in every jurisdiction,' 'Filing and payments, done for you,' and 'Physical nexus tracking,' plus certificate/exemption handling that applies across regimes. Missing for 10: explicit named confirmation of EU OSS/IOSS or Canada/Australia GST mechanics, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration of filing accuracy in non-US jurisdictions.
